# flx-platformer

The demo game: a menu state, a play state, a player with animations and input, chasing enemies in a group,
recycled bullets, and a floor made of a tile block. Written from scratch for XNA Reborn.
`data/sprites.png` (a 64 by 16 sheet of four coloured 16 by 16 frames) and `data/jump.wav` (a short generated sine tone)
were generated by script. No third-party code or assets.

Language features it exercises: Number fields without initializers, int / int, closures, getters and setters,
`for each`, `super()` first, `Vector.<T>`, Function values and class values.
